_note: CUST-HV V7b — publish gate for explicit header text / icon colours. Shared by PHP HeaderDesignContrast and both TS twins (headerContrastIssues). Only the explicit `text` / `icon` are proven here, against the designed header background if there is one, else the default surface #ffffff plus a custom palette.surface; the automatic text over a designed background is the best of pure white / black and passes by construction. `ratio` is the worst ratio rounded to 2 decimals.

cases.name: a background alone is fine — its text is automatic and proven by construction
explicit white text on the default surface fails
explicit dark text on the default surface passes
dark text on a dark designed background fails
white text on a dark designed background passes
a role resolves through the palette: brand text on a brand background fails
a pale icon on the default surface fails on its own
icon and text can both fail, in field order
a dark palette surface is a backdrop when the header has no background of its own
a designed background replaces the palette surface as the judged backdrop
a mid grey background is judged exactly, not by luminance class
